original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds support for AWS WAF logs stored in S3 to Lambda-Promtail.

decision.reason: [ev-c63a71bf0be5] only says that Lambda-Promtail gained support for WAF logs in S3. That is an additive, opt-in feature, and the evidence names no flag, key or configuration that would expose an environment. The proposed condition matches any promtail that has --config.file or PROMTAIL_CONFIG set. That is far too broad: it would flag almost every standard promtail deployment, which is not Lambda-Promtail and is not affected by a new log source. The evidence supports no correct exposure predicate, so no correction can be derived.
